seed.content: Allotment: what to grow this year
Beans: borlotti on the back fence, sown in late April

rounds.user: The beans go in two rows on tall canes from the shed.
rounds.assistant: Beans: two rows, tall canes from the shed.

rounds.user: Water them every second evening once the pods set; last year I overwatered.
rounds.assistant: Beans: water every second evening after pod set; last year's overwatering noted.

rounds.user: Harvest in September, dry the pods indoors for two weeks.
rounds.assistant: Beans: harvest September, dry pods indoors two weeks.
